verdict.rationale: There is no documented workspace export feature. Linear's data can be pulled out through its GraphQL API, whose introspection exposes the whole schema, and through Fivetran and Airbyte connectors that sync Linear data to warehouses. That makes extraction possible with extra tooling, but nothing confirms that comments, attachments or audit trails are preserved. Missing for 10: a native workspace export feature, documented preservation of comments, attachments and audit logs, and hands-on confirmation of export completeness.
